checks: independent oracle, two normalized runs, rejected source mutation
cost: O(E+V log(V+1)) time and O(V) auxiliary space
description: Original deterministic topological_sort, global validation and bounded independent oracle.
forward: Validate all edges in adjacency order; malformed graphs return first InvalidEdge. Valid graphs with a cycle return Cycle. Otherwise return the lexicographically least permutation p in which every edge tail precedes its head; empty graph returns [].
inverse: In U=domain inputs crossed with all declared return values for one call, C=U minus R where R is the forward specification. This excludes every wrong successful vector/order, incorrect error and wrong first-failure precedence. Exact for the specification; partial source-derived absent-behavior approximant for Rust. Allocation failure, panic and elapsed time are outside U.

For every return y, Pre(y)={G | R(G,y)} retains ALL compatible graphs. Successful fibers contain all DAGs with y as lexicographically first valid ordering, including compatible parallel-edge multiplicities. Error fibers contain all graphs satisfying the exact invalid-edge or cycle rule. No source argument, unique recovery or implemented inverse executor is assumed.
limitations: Bounded tests are not unrestricted proof.
Syntax projection excludes expansion and semantic resolution.
state: all finite directed adjacency lists with duplicates and self loops; outputs are tagged errors or vertex permutations
